newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson claims victory in consent recount. [CORRECTED 21:33 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson claims victory in consent recount. [CORRECTED 21:33 GMT]

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson and Co on Monday said a preliminary recount showed three of its consent proposals were approved by shareholders of Great Western Financial Corp.

On its proposal No. 3, Ahmanson received a majority on April 9 by a margin of more than 500,000 shares, it said. By April 15 (corrects date from April 25), another 3.46 million shares were voted in favor of the proposal, which would require Great Western to hold its annual meeting by May 6. The recount excluded any shares that were voted twice.
Great Western, which as agreed to merge with Washington Mutual Inc, has scheduled its annual meeting for June 13. Ahmanson has a competing offer to acquire Great Western.

On its proposal No. 4, Ahmanson said the preliminary recount showed it had a majority of 797,000 voted by April 10. On its proposal No. 5, it had a majority of 796,000 by April 10. Ahmanson said another 2.1 million shares had been voted in favor of proposals No. 4 and No. 5 by April 15.
Proposal No. 4 deals with the quorum for shareholder votes and proposal No. 5 concerns amendments to bylaws.
